name: Hotel Jägerhof
beschreibung: Hotel Jägerhof is situated on a scenic high plateau in Kolsassberg, overlooking the Inn Valley towards the gateway of the Zillertal. Its elevated vantage point provides sweeping panoramic views of the Karwendel Mountains. Nearby ski areas like Glungezer and Kellerjoch are reachable within minutes, and summer hiking and mountain biking routes begin right outside. The family-run inn features rustic alpine decor, an indoor pool, a sauna and steam wellness suite, and half-board dining.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Jägerhof in Kolsassberg above the Inn Valley features panoramic Karwendel views, an indoor swimming pool, a sauna area, and regional half-board dining.
